en.headline: Man dies after drowning off Kiu Tsui Chau in Sai Kung
en.dek: Police received a report at about 2.42am that someone was drowning; a passing sampan rescued the man and took him to Ho Chung Pier, where he was later pronounced dead at hospital.
body: A man died early on Thursday after being found drowning in the waters off Kiu Tsui Chau in Sai Kung.
Police said they received a report at around 2.42am that someone was drowning. A passing sampan rescued the man and brought him to Ho Chung Pier.
Rescuers arrived to find the man unconscious. He was taken by ambulance to Tseung Kwan O Hospital, where he was pronounced dead at 3.49am.
Police are investigating the circumstances of the incident. No further details about the man's identity or age were immediately available.

zh.headline: 西貢橋咀洲附近有男子溺毙
zh.dek: 警方約凌晨2時42分接報有人遇溺，途經舡艈將男子救起送往蠣湧碼頭，其後在將軍澳醫院證實不治。
body: 一名男子周四凌晨在西貢橋咀洲附近水域遇溺身亡。
警方表示，約凌晨2時42分接獲有人遇溺報告。一艘途經的舡艈將男子救起，並送往蠣湧碼頭。
救援人員到場時發現男子已失去知覺。他其後被送往將軍澳醫院，於凌晨3時49分證實死亡。
警方正在調查事件經過。暫時未有進一步資料公開男子的身份或年齡。
